snippet.title: Gate Zero - Combat Gameplay Reveal // Templar Media
snippet.description:
Gate Zero is a semi-open world action-adventure game set in ancient Israel that allows the player to explore history and Biblical events. As Max, a teen from a dystopian future, players utilize their own mix of combat, stealth, dialogue, and abilities to save history and get back to their own time.

Coming SPRING 2027 to Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Epic Games Store.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1748280/Gate_Zero/
Wishlist on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019505
Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/gate-zero/9pj41kdgmv89

Gate Zero is published by Templar Media: https://templarmedia.com/
